blocks.text: From Old East Slavic слѣдъ, from Proto-Slavic *slědъ, from Proto-Balto-Slavic *sláidus, from Proto-Indo-European *h₃sleydʰ-.

head: Word
Part of speech
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to follow (move continually behind someone or something); to follow (in sequence), to be next
to watch, to follow, to spy; to look after (e.g. health)
to pursue, to chase; to persecute
without a trace, tracelessly, completely, utterly (of a disappearance)
